description: The primary skill damage buff. Handles HP-based, ATK-based, and attribute-based damage with extensive sub-type system. Supports healing, skill crit, normal crit, boss damage, resistance, and full interaction pipeline with EXTRA_DAMAGE, GIANT_SLAYER, VAMPIRE, SKILL_REAL_DAMAGE, SKILL_DAMAGE_ADD, SKILL_RETURN, and RECORD_DAMAGE.

HpType.note: Bitfield. Add=heal, Sub=damage(unused in code directly), Attack=from caster, Target=from target for attribute reads

IgnoreFlag.note: Bitfield controlling which crit/multiplier systems to skip or use

param2.description: Calculation sub-type (0-10). Determines base damage source.

param4.description: Bitfield: 1=skip SkillCrit, 2=ignore T1045 (set skill_dam_extra to 1), 4=use normal crit instead

param5.description: Array of [minMultiplier, maxMultiplier] for damage clamping based on base ATK damage

type_0.name: Attribute-based
type_0.description: Read any attribute from target or caster based on hpType flags

type_2.name: HP Difference (caster max HP - target current HP)

type_5.name: Target's own ATK damage
type_5.formula: ATK = target.att; ATK_DAM = target.att_dam; value = roundInt(max(roundInt(ATK - DEF * (1 + DEF_COE)), 1) * ATK_DAM)

type_10.name: Partner ATK damage
type_10.formula: ATK_DAM = caster.att_dam; if caster.parent exists and not callType: ATK = parent.att; partner_dam = caster.partner_dam; partner_dam_extra = caster.partner_dam_extra; ATK_DAM = round(ATK_DAM * partner_dam * partner_dam_extra); value = roundInt(max(roundInt(ATK - DEF * (1 + DEF_COE)), 1) * ATK_DAM)

heal_path.formula: healAmount = roundInt(baseValue * skillPar); healthTarget(target, healAmount, HealthType.Treat)

hp_damage_path.condition: calType in [2, 3, 8, 9] OR (calType == 0 AND attribId == hp)
hp_damage_path.formula: damage = roundInt(baseValue * skillPar); damage = roundInt(damage * injuryReduce); if _limit: clamp to [baseDMG * limit[0], baseDMG * limit[1]]
hp_damage_path.notes: Bypasses skill damage pipeline (no crit, no resistance, no EXTRA_DAMAGE)

skill_damage_path.condition: All other calTypes when not Add
steps: 3. Add SKILL_DAMAGE_ADD bonus from caster's buffs
4. Apply skill_dam_extra multiplier (unless T1045 flag set): damage = roundInt(damage * skill_dam_extra)
5. If SkillCrit check passes (and not ignored): damage *= round(1 + skill_crit_dam); damage = roundInt(pow(damage, 0.98))
6. If UseCrit flag and normal crit: critMul = max(1.5, round(crit_dam / max(0.5, crit_def)))
7. Apply boss_dam: if target is Boss and boss_dam > 0: damage *= round(1 + boss_dam)
9. Apply RECORD_DAMAGE bonus: damage *= round(1 + round(recordDamage / 10000))
11. Apply resistance: resistPar based on calType
16. If skill crit: trigger STATE_TRIGER(Skill_Crit) and SKILL_CRIT effects

resistanceByCalType.type_10: partner_resist via calSuppressAndInspire (uses parent as reference)
